name: Holmium
occurrence: Found in trace amounts within monazite and gadolinite ores.
majorUses: Highest-magnetic-strength pole pieces for the strongest man-made magnetic fields (used inside other magnets)
Yttrium-iron-garnet laser crystals used in medical/dental surgery
notableCharacteristics: Has the highest magnetic permeability of any element, making it uniquely useful for concentrating magnetic flux inside the world's strongest electromagnets.
whyHere: Its eleven 4f electrons produce an unusually high magnetic permeability — meaning it channels and concentrates magnetic field lines more effectively than any other element — which is exactly why it's used inside the pole tips of the strongest laboratory magnets on Earth.
didYouKnow: Holmium is named after Stockholm (its Latin name 'Holmia'), continuing the periodic table's tradition of Scandinavian-city-named rare earths.
genZNote: Highest magnetic permeability of any element, full stop. Basically a magnet's favorite hype man.
